React Integration with

integrates with React through /react. The package extends the core contract with useSyncExternalStore() for render-time State access.

React package usage

can run in a React application without /react. The core APIs remain available, but the React render-time subscription surface is supplied only by the React package.

React Integration
/react is a React integration wrapper around the core APIs. It preserves the core FluentApi, synchronous State Snapshot, and State Stream while adding an explicit React render-time subscription method.
Initial State requires a render-time connection

Without /react and useSyncExternalStore(), a React component must provide its own render-time integration with State. A subscription created after initialization can miss the emission that committed the initial State, leaving that State absent from the first render.

Later State updates may still render correctly, creating a false-positive result: subsequent updates appear to work even though the initial render was never connected to the current Snapshot. A custom integration must read the current Snapshot during render and remain connected to subsequent State changes.

Installation

The React extension is available from the /react package on npm. 

{{`npm install @sdux-vault/react`}}

Download /react from npm →

useSyncExternalStore()

useSyncExternalStore() connects the current React render to State and returns the latest immutable Snapshot. The same surface provides the current Snapshot during render and connects the component to subsequent State changes.
